motion.name: Entrance / Homepage
motion.trigger: First visit, after fonts and navigation are ready.
motion.motion: Header links fade in and rise 12 px with a 140 ms delay and 70 ms step (power2.out). The portrait fades in, rises 18 px and scales .97 → 1; copy rises 18 px with a 200 ms step (power3.out). Portrait starts at 100 ms and copy at 300 ms in the content timeline.
motion.playback: Runs once per page load. Desktop reveals the poster and copy before the portrait turn buffer; mobile waits for prepared portrait frames. Leaving the tab settles the entrance.
motion.reduced: Show the final content immediately. Missing GSAP or failed portrait preparation keeps the page readable.
motion.preview: The component preview is static. Open the live homepage to see its page entrance.

motion.name: Entrance / Reading content
motion.trigger: First paint, then each prepared block as it enters the viewport.
motion.motion: Fade 0 → 1 and rise 8px using cubic-bezier(.37,0,.63,1). The title leads the intro paragraphs. Blocks enter in reading order with one shared step; newly visible batches continue the sequence behind first-paint blocks.
motion.playback: Reading-page blocks appear once. Reverse scrolling does not replay them. Hash navigation, keyboard focus and history restoration expose the relevant text immediately. The 404 page reuses the CSS entrance for its title and copy at first paint.
motion.reduced: All reading content is visible without entrance animation. CSS first paint and the optional observer preserve readable content if JavaScript is unavailable.

motion.name: Portrait / Turn & interaction
motion.trigger: Prepared welcome frames, pointer movement, drag or keyboard input.
motion.motion: One welcome turn eases to the front with sine ease-in-out. Desktop pointer following reaches ±49° and softens within 1.5 portrait widths of the face. Drag allows full turns; release returns to the nearest front with a damped spring and a small overshoot. Android uses its separate touch player.
motion.playback: There is no idle loop. Manual input cancels the welcome and takes priority over follow/scroll. A new press interrupts the spring. Mobile scroll pose follows actual occlusion; menu close returns to the front. These interactions run on the live homepage; the portrait specimen shows static poses.
motion.reduced: Static front portrait; no animation-frame ZIP requests. Hidden tabs suspend movement; errors retain the poster.

motion.name: Entrance / Project content
motion.trigger: A card enters view and its own preview has loaded or failed.
motion.motion: Text fades in and rises 14 px with a 70 ms step (power2.out). Desktop artwork rises 14 px and fades over 800 ms. Mobile artwork uses a pure 1150 ms sine.inOut fade after 12% of the image is visible, capped at 48 px; visible description starts no earlier than 420 ms after the image, then actions 140 ms after description.
motion.playback: Decode and actual visibility gate the preview. A fast jump restores an image already passed so copy can continue. Returning all the way to the intro resets HOME reveals; ordinary card-to-card reverse scrolling keeps revealed content.
motion.reduced: Readable cards in normal flow; no reveal or overlapping scene animation. Image errors expose the existing Preview unavailable state.
motion.preview: The component preview shows the artwork and content. The live homepage runs the scroll-triggered entrance.

motion.name: Navigation / Mobile menu
motion.trigger: Activate the mobile menu toggle or close the menu.
motion.motion: The same three SVG strokes morph into a cross over 200 ms ease-in-out. Opening fades the panel over 280 ms (power2.out); links fade/rise 12 px over 320 ms with a 55 ms step, starting at 70 ms (power3.out). Closing sends links down 12 px over 240 ms in reverse order (power3.in), then fades the panel over 280 ms (power2.inOut).
motion.playback: Rapid toggles cancel the active timeline and follow the latest requested state. Scroll is locked while open; closing restores the page and relevant focus.
motion.reduced: Toggle and menu settle immediately. Missing GSAP retains working open/close controls; hidden/changed-layout transitions settle.

motion.name: Control / Surface feedback
motion.usage: AI brief · Back · shared pill frame
motion.trigger: Hover or press an enabled control.
motion.motion: Background and border colors transition within the fixed control frame; control dimensions stay stable. Disabled More Details and the Manual copy heading do not animate on activation.
motion.playback: Reverses to the default colors when hover/press ends. Manual copy keeps the existing heading and native logos mounted.
motion.reduced: Brief and Back feedback changes immediately; disabled states remain static.

motion.name: Link / Underline
motion.trigger: Hover a link; keyboard focus also reveals the header underline.
motion.motion: The 1 px line scales horizontally from 0 → 1 using cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1). It follows the label width; the transform origin switches to make entry and exit directional.
motion.playback: Reverses on pointer leave. Mobile menu links have their own presentation; footer hover is limited to hover-capable fine pointers. Keyboard focus uses the shared outline.

motion.name: AI brief / Logo motion
motion.usage: Light & Dark AI brief · Homepage · About
motion.trigger: Desktop fine-pointer hover, or activate the enabled Brief button.
motion.motion: Hover moves each logo 0 → −2 → 0 px, with a 140 ms step. Leaving hover returns current poses to baseline over 240 ms. Activation sends one −9 px wave with a 70 ms step, starting from current poses. Each half uses cubic-bezier(.37,0,.63,1).
motion.playback: Hover loops only while eligible. A click wave finishes before hover can resume; repeated clicks keep the current wave. Manual copy disables motion; hiding the tab cancels it.
motion.reduced: No logo movement. Mobile has no hover loop; normal activation can still play the single wave when reduced motion is off.

motion.name: AI brief / Copy confirmation
motion.usage: Light & Dark AI brief · Homepage · About
motion.timing: 320 ms fade · next label starts at 360 ms
motion.motion: Fade the outgoing label out, leave a 40 ms separation, then fade in the other label over 320 ms using cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1). The check shares the Copied label’s opacity; the button frame stays fixed.
motion.playback: Copied is requested for 2200 ms after success, then the sequence reverses to Brief your AI. Copy failure exposes selectable Manual copy instead.
motion.reduced: Labels switch immediately; confirmation and manual-copy behavior remain available.

motion.name: Scroll / Work panels
motion.trigger: Actual page scrolling through the intro and project panels.
motion.motion: The next full-height panel covers the previous one. An outgoing project fades 1 → 0 and scales 1 → 0.975. The intro has its own recede: opacity 1 → .38, scale 1 → .955 and up to −18 px. Mobile uses native sticky surfaces and preserves reading space for taller cards.
motion.playback: Stopping scroll holds the pose; reversing scroll restores it. Fully covered surfaces become inert. Resize preserves the current reading position. The live homepage owns this composition; the card specimen documents its content.
motion.reduced: Ordinary readable list without overlapping transforms. Short/fallback layouts keep content in flow.

motion.name: Scroll / Contact footer
motion.trigger: The contact footer covers the preceding content.
motion.timing: Scroll progress · corners flatten in final quarter
motion.motion: The outgoing surface fades and recedes to scale 0.975. Footer upper corners go from 40px → 0 after 75% cover, using smoothstep. The incoming footer follows native sticky/scroll geometry.
motion.playback: Reverse scrolling restores the previous surface and round corners. Reading-page content waits until its natural end before the footer covers it. Menu scroll lock and hidden tabs preserve the current pose.
motion.reduced: Footer follows content in ordinary flow; the overlap effect is removed.

motion.name: Navigation / Work anchor
motion.trigger: Activate navigation to a work section.
motion.motion: Animate the real scroll position to the requested scene; the same scene renderer paints the intermediate panel poses.
motion.playback: The destination receives focus once its content is visible when requested. User scrolling cancels the active navigation tween. Fallback layouts position the page immediately.
motion.reduced: Navigate immediately with readable focus targets.

motion.name: Status / Coming Soon
motion.trigger: The current project action is visible and uncovered.
motion.motion: The original 12 px dot pulses opacity .4 → 1 → .4. Text and the disabled action stay still.
motion.playback: Pauses offscreen, when the document is hidden, behind the mobile menu or when its surface is covered. Continues while visible.

motion.name: Loading / Library SVGs
motion.trigger: A visible, slowly loaded native SVG or a complete Brief logo row finishes decoding.
motion.motion: Fade 0 → 1 using cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1). Brief logos appear as one prepared row; ready/offscreen assets appear immediately.
motion.playback: The gallery prepares actual image nodes in visual order. State changes do not restart loading or replace the SVGs. This loading presentation belongs only to the DS.
motion.reduced: Prepared assets appear immediately without a fade.
